acceptance: Local TPC-DI bundles are rerun with the current native generator (seed 42) at every published scale
Their table row counts and QVQ12/QAQ7 result counts match the cloud bundles at each scale
The superseded local bundles are replaced through the normal corpus PR path, and the CORPUS_NOTES caveat is updated
context: Found during the live-cloud corpus publication (PRs #2602 and #2615). Rerunning the local engines costs nothing.
description: The published TPC-DI cohorts mix two data versions. The cloud bundles (BigQuery, Snowflake and Databricks at SF 0.1, 1 and 10) were loaded after the generator change in #2220 (`cac8582a0`). They agree on all sixteen table row counts and on QVQ12/QAQ7 result counts: 100/1 at SF 0.1, 32/2 at SF 1, 1/1 at SF 10. The local TPC-DI bundles in the corpus predate that change and report QVQ12=9 and QAQ7=1 at SF 1. So local and cloud timings in the same cohort are measured over different data. results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md section "TPC-DI cloud data comparison (2026-10-03)" discloses this.
